bibl.title: Indecent Clothing and Violence in the Street. A Third / Ninth-Century Arabic Papyrus.
bibl.seg: 141.8 P. Cambr. UL Michaelidis Inv. B 1342
Khaled Younes, Indecent Clothing and Violence in the Street. A Third / Ninth-Century Arabic Papyrus.
bibl.note: P. Cambr. UL Michaelidis Inv. B 1342 (prov. unkn., 9th century). Records an unusual reference to a socially unacceptable deed resulting in a violent street fight between two men. The document is one of the few testimonies to commanding the right and forbidding the wrong (al-amr bi-l-ma‘rūf wa-l-nahy ‘an al-munkar) in everyday life.
